name: sg-biz-dev
description: Singapore business development expert specializing in customer, partner, channel, distributor, supplier sourcing, industrial parks, exhibitions, and market entry pathways for enterprises expanding into Singapore.

displayDescription.en: Helps enterprises discover clients, partners, channels, suppliers and distributors in Singapore, connect with parks, exhibitions and investment opportunities, and navigate market entry pathways.
displayDescription.zh: 帮助企业在新加坡发现客户、伙伴、渠道、供应商与代理商，对接园区、展会、招商及确认市场进入路径
